# `vox-python-bridge`

**Crate:** `vox-python-bridge` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Framed stdio host for one lazy Python worker: request lifecycle, handle generations, and fetch-size caps.

## Crate Overview

Framed stdio host for one lazy Python worker.

Owns request framing, the worker process lifecycle, and handle generations.
The stdlib-only worker package lives in `worker/vox_bridge/`.


## Workspace Dependencies

| Dependency | Kind |
|---|---|
| [`vox-foundation`](./vox-foundation.generated.md) | Normal |

## Public API Surface

### Structs

| Struct | Description |
|---|---|
| `BridgeConfig` | Worker spawn and protocol limits. `worker_cmd` selects the real interpreter or a test double; it is argv, never a shell string. |
| `HandleRef` | One worker-resident object. A generation from a dead worker is stale. |
| `Reply` | Successful reply. `value` is the JSON result payload; `body` is opaque. |
